title: Wednesday assorted links
contentHtml:
1. “We were discussing this today in office: future paper is 5 pages (what’s question, where is lit now very briefly, what do we do, what do we find), with all details left to a long appendix, hyperlinked, with rigorous AI review. We would read many more papers in that world! Agree?”  Kevin Bryan.

2. “Norway now has more than 2,000 underwater AI laser robots shooting lice off its salmon”

3. Coefficient Giving is looking to support new types of organizations.

4. The future of fermented food in Africa.

5. Shruti and Henry Oliver podcast with transcript on Gulliver’s Travels.

6. Houellebecq probed over comments about Muslims.
